about_short_description.short_description: Avion is an autonomous aerial network that delivers medicals and vaccine supplies via drones.

product.name: Avion Medical Drone Delivery Network
product.description: An autonomous eVTOL drone network that connects remote clinics with urban healthcare infrastructure for delivery of medical supplies and transport of clinical samples.

product.name: Avion Digital Health Platform
product.description: A digital interface that lets healthcare providers order medical supplies, schedule clinical sample transport, track shipments, and communicate with laboratories and pharmacies.

product.name: Medical Supply Delivery
product.description: An autonomous drone delivery service for transporting medical supplies, including vaccines and other vital healthcare materials, to remote clinics and hard-to-reach locations.

product.name: Clinical Sample Transport
product.description: An autonomous drone service that transports clinical samples from remote clinics to urban laboratories for testing and analysis.
